The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 c054f7856b32267e), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF pages 13-14. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. statement: Let a spin patch of diameter at most r be separated from prescribed remote spins ζ by pure shells of one of the types in Lemma 3.2, out to distance R = dr. Allow fixed proportional 13 buffers around the patch and the outer cut. Let H be a bounded real function of the patch spins and of any independent auxiliary variables in the patch. In the free/free case assume that the region inside the shell has no pinned spins and that H is invariant under reversal of all its spin arguments. There are constants C < ∞ and η > 0 such that osc ζ Epure[H | ζ] ≤ Ca(d)∥H∥∞, (3.14) osc ζ log Epure[eH | ζ] ≤ Ca(d)∥H∥∞, (3.15) where a(d) = d−2 at a straight homogeneous side and a(d) = d−η at a corner or boundary-condition change. Here osc f = sup f − inf f. The bounds hold for each fixed sufficiently large d and sufficiently fine mesh, with thresholds chosen simultaneously for any finite collection of ratios.
